newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-ROSARIO SCARE DISJOINTED SPRINGBOKS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ROSARIO SCARE DISJOINTED SPRINGBOKS.

text.p: Argentine amateurs Rosario came close to an upset of the world champion Springboks at the Duendes club on Tuesday. South Africa won 45-36, but ended defending grimly against an inspired Rosario team.
The Springboks began brilliantly with five unaswered tries in the first 23 minutes, the result of powerful driving from the forwards and slick handling among the backs.

Prop Toks van der Linde drove over for the opening score in the first minute. New cap Dick Muir went over for the first of his two tries in the eighth minute and rounded off the tourists' great start with a score from turned over lineout ball.

But Rosario fought back and scored the first of their five tries through lock forward Raul Perez two minutes later. Scrumhalf Rodrigo Crexell slotted a penalty on the stroke of half time as the hosts turned round 33-10 down.
Springbok captain Wayne Fyvie scored the first try of the second half and wing Justin Swart raced over on the hour. But the rest of the half belonged to a rejuvenated Rosario team.

Crexell scored a breakaway try in the 55th minute and left wing Gonzalo Acuna crossed in the 63rd minute. Then the try of the match came after Springbok flyhalf Franco Smith failed to find touch from a long kick downfield.
Fullback Ezequiel Jurado linked with right wing Lisandro Dippe, who sliced through the midfield before setting up the score for centre Diego Flook in the 72nd minute.
Prop Carlos Promancio rounded off the scoring as the referee blew full time, much to the relief of a shellshocked Springbok team.
